blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Talent manager and ALV Pageant Circle Pres. Arnold Vegafria is confident that his bet to the 2026 Miss Asia Pacific International pageant, Gabrielle Galapia, will deliver another crown. One of the most prolific national directors in the Philippines faced members of the media after Galapia score two major wins at the pageant’s recent Preliminary Competition and expressed optimism for his delegate’s chances of clinching the title. “She knows that I believe in her. I really fought for her, and I chose her to compete in Miss Asia Pacific International, and it’s my personal choice,” Vegafria responded to […]...
